explanation: Two-body head-on collision within single dt=0.00357s causes ~6x energy gain. Initial energy ~3712 J jumps to 23651 J after 6 substeps resolving overlap (gap -0.00088) with zero controller_work. Bodies approach at high relative speed 58 m/s. Impulse+positional correction injects kinetic energy instead of conserving/dissipating (e=0.9/0.3). Separating bodies eliminates violation.
